milestones.title: Foundations
milestones.summary: Set up configuration loading and the shared building blocks—error classes, ID generation, pagination, request logging, and input validation—that every later module will depend on.

milestones.title: Domain Models
milestones.summary: Define the core data shapes and primitives for products, orders, payments, users, and authentication before any business logic is written.

milestones.title: Storage and Business Logic
milestones.summary: Build the in-memory repositories and then layer the product catalog, user, cart, and order services and auth middleware on top of them.

milestones.title: Wiring and HTTP API
milestones.summary: Wire every service together through a dependency container, expose them as REST routes, assemble the Express app, and start the server.

steps.title: Configuration and error handling
steps.goal: loadConfig() returns a valid Config object from environment variables with sensible defaults, and the error factories plus errorHandler middleware produce correct HTTP status codes and JSON error bodies

steps.title: Shared utilities: IDs, pagination, logging, validation
steps.goal: paginate() correctly slices arrays and returns page metadata, uuid/sequentialIds generate usable identifiers, requestLogger logs method/path/status/duration, and validate() parses input or throws a formatted 400 error

steps.title: Product, order, and payment models
steps.goal: MockPaymentProvider.charge() succeeds for valid card tokens and fails for declined ones, refund() records the refunded reference, and the order state machine's transitions map correctly allows or rejects status changes

steps.title: User model, password hashing, and JWT tokens
steps.goal: hashPassword/verifyPassword correctly identify matching versus non-matching passwords, TokenService.sign/verify issues valid JWTs and rejects tampered or expired ones, and toPublicUser strips the password hash from a User

steps.title: In-memory repositories
steps.goal: Each repository's save/findById/all (plus findByUser, findByEmail, count) correctly stores and retrieves records in memory

steps.title: Product catalog service
steps.goal: ProductsService.create/list/get/update manage the catalog correctly, list() applies search/filter/sort/pagination from validated query input, and reserveStock/releaseStock adjust inventory while rejecting insufficient or inactive stock

steps.title: User registration and authentication service
steps.goal: UsersService.register creates a user (granting admin role to the first user registered) and returns a token, login authenticates correct credentials and rejects invalid ones, and getProfile returns public user data

steps.title: Authentication and role middleware
steps.goal: requireAuth attaches the decoded user to requests carrying a valid Bearer token and rejects missing or invalid ones, requireRole blocks users lacking the required role, and currentUserId extracts the authenticated user's id or throws

steps.title: Shopping cart service
steps.goal: CartService.add/setQuantity/clear/get manage a user's in-memory cart quantities, computing per-line and total costs while validating that products are active and available

steps.title: Order processing service
steps.goal: OrdersService.checkout reserves stock, charges the cart total, creates an order, and clears the cart, releasing stock and refunding if payment fails; changeStatus enforces valid transitions, role permissions, and releases stock on cancellation

steps.title: Dependency injection container
steps.goal: createContainer() instantiates repositories, token service, payment provider, and all domain services, wiring their dependencies together into one object, and accepts overrides for testing

steps.title: Product catalog routes
steps.goal: GET /products lists and paginates products, GET /products/:id returns one product, and admin-only POST /products and PATCH /products/:id create and update products

steps.title: User and auth routes
steps.goal: POST /auth/register and POST /auth/login return a user profile and token on success or the correct error status on failure, and GET /me returns the authenticated caller's profile

steps.title: Cart routes
steps.goal: Authenticated GET/POST /cart and PATCH /cart/:productId/quantity correctly read, add to, and update the caller's own cart

steps.title: Orders routes
steps.goal: POST /orders/checkout creates an order from the caller's cart, GET /orders lists the caller's orders, GET /orders/:id enforces access control, and PATCH /orders/:id/status transitions order status

steps.title: Express app factory
steps.goal: createApp() assembles all routers and middleware into a working app: a full register → login → browse products → add to cart → checkout flow succeeds end-to-end, and unmatched routes return 404

steps.title: Server entry point
steps.goal: Running the entry point starts an HTTP server on the configured port that accepts and responds to real requests
